extraction.Name: Palmer Howard Lamoureaux
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded April 18, 1919, by Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Valentine State Bank for $1570; quit claim deed signed by Lamoureaux and wife on September 19, 1921, in favor of Augusta M. Lamoureaux for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612463 issued; Northwest quarter section 23, township 97, north of range 75; land mortgaged March 17, 1919; receipt for patent signed by allottee but not dated
